title: A line of plugins.jsonl
description: One DLL plugin for Stellaris Launcher. Its files live in a zip of the author's own GitHub release; this line says where, and what is in it.

id.description: The id of the plugin's stl-plugin.json (lower case, digits and dashes).

description.description: What it does, in a sentence or two.

version.description: The version of the zip (the version of its stl-plugin.json).

download.description: The zip: an asset of a release of `repository` on GitHub. It holds stl-plugin.json and the DLL, at its root or in one folder.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the zip, in lower-case hex.

repository.description: The plugin's source: a GitHub repository.

game_builds.description: The stellaris.exe builds it is made for, as in its stl-plugin.json (`game.exe_timestamps`). Empty: it checks for itself.

game_version.description: The game version those builds are, for people (`4.5.2`).

homepage.description: A page for people, when it is not the repository.
